verdicts.note: Small parted-lips opening with a hint of tongue below the mustache, mustache intact and parts naturally, clean flat-color, no seam. Reads clearly less open than the 'open' candidates.
Slightly larger oval opening with tongue curling forward; mustache intact, no seam/style break. Still visibly less open than 'open' candidates, though closer in size to the 'oh' candidates.
Wide open mouth, dark cavity above a full rounded tongue, mustache parts symmetrically, no seam or artifact.
Wide open mouth, slightly more rounded/symmetric than c0, tongue well-centered, mustache clean, no seam.
Mouth reads as a small downturned pursed slit, not a round open 'O' shape — barely more open than BASE and the wrong silhouette for 'oh'.
Oval/round open mouth with tongue tip visible, plausible 'O' shape, mustache and cheeks intact, no seam.
Cleanest round vertical-oval 'O' opening with a small tongue peek, mustache intact, no seam — best on-model round shape of the three.
Left eye is fully closed but the right eye clearly shows an open eyeball (white sclera + black pupil) under a lowered lid — a wink, not a blink. Fails the 'both eyes fully closed' requirement.
Same defect as c0: left eye closed, right eye shows a visible pupil/white highlight through a narrowed lid — asymmetric wink, not a full blink.
Small parted opening with a hint of tongue peeking through the mustache gap, clearly less open than the open/oh candidates; mustache and surrounding features intact, clean seam.

Opening is too wide/uneven for 'half' (reads closer to 'open'), mustache is asymmetric with the right side sagging lower than the left, and there is a stray pink patch below-right of the mouth that doesn't belong to any anatomical feature — garbled region.
Wide open mouth, mustache parts naturally in a V, dark interior with visible lower lip; a small white fleck on the left interior reads as a tooth highlight, not a defect.
Wide open mouth, clean symmetric mustache part, dark interior with pink lower lip, no stray artifacts — slightly cleaner than c0.
Opening is barely visible (a thin dark line under the mustache), nearly indistinguishable from BASE's closed mouth — fails to read as a round open 'oh' shape.

Mustache splits into a sharp V with a wedge-shaped maroon opening; this reads as a generic wide-open mouth rather than a rounded 'O', and is too similar in shape to the open__c* candidates to serve as a distinct oh viseme.
Mustache stays intact and a distinct small oval/round mouth opening appears below it — the cleanest, most on-model round 'O' shape of the three.
Eyes are unchanged from BASE's smug half-lidded open eyes — pupils and whites fully visible, not closed at all. Clear fail on the strict blink requirement.
Same as c0 — eyes remain open/half-lidded, no closure regenerated; essentially a no-op relative to BASE.
Mustache parts cleanly, small visible pink opening under it — clearly less open than the open/oh candidates, right eye/mustache otherwise match BASE. Good half.
Opening is not clearly smaller than the 'open' candidates and the tongue tip pokes past the left mustache boundary — reads as an anatomy glitch rather than a distinct half-open shape.
Clean wide-open mouth, dark teeth-ridge line plus pink interior, mustache parts naturally, no seam or discoloration.
Wide open mouth with teeth ridge and tongue, on-model; slightly more asymmetric right corner than c0 but not a failure.
Mustache is unparted and mouth region is pixel-for-pixel the same closed shape as BASE — no 'oh' opening was generated at all.
Mouth interior shows a muddy maroon/burgundy-toned patch (reads like color bleed from the cardigan) instead of the clean pink used elsewhere — discolored, garbled interior.
Clean round O-shaped opening with visible pink tongue, mustache parts symmetrically, no discoloration or seam.
Right eye still shows the full open white sclera + dark pupil from BASE with only a stray eyelash line drawn over it — this is still a wink, not both-eyes-closed blink.
Same failure as c0 — right eye's white/pupil remains fully visible, eye is not actually closed. Fails the strict blink requirement.
Small parted-lip opening visible under mustache, hint of teeth/pink, mustache intact and splits naturally around the opening, no seam or discoloration at mask boundary.
Clean small opening, slightly less busy than c0 (no stray mark near mustache tip), mustache and nose intact, reads as slightly-parted mouth distinct from BASE.
Wide open mouth with visible dark/red interior and tongue, clearly more open than the half/oh candidates, mustache parts naturally, no garbling or seam visible.
Wide open mouth with red interior and tongue, slightly narrower than c0 but still clearly 'open', mustache intact, no seam artifacts.
Small round pink opening, mustache splits cleanly around it, on-model; the faint mark right of the mustache tip is also present in BASE (nose/mustache shading), not an inpaint artifact.
Small round pink-red O-shaped opening, mustache intact, consistent with oh__c0/c2, no seam or style break.
Rounder and slightly larger O-shaped opening than c0/c1, cleanest read as a distinct round mouth shape, mustache and cheeks undamaged.
Both eyes fully closed with matching curved lash lines, symmetric, no wink or half-closed eye, rest of face untouched.
Eyes are open with the same round pupils/highlights as BASE - no closure at all, both eyes essentially unchanged from BASE. Fails the blink intent entirely.
Small parted mouth visible under mustache, tongue tip and dark cavity read clearly, mustache parts naturally, no seam/style artifacts.
Slightly larger parted opening than c0, mustache intact, clean edges, no artifacts — valid half-open.

Right side of the mouth-mustache boundary is blurred/feathered (not crisp linework like the rest of the art), plus a glowing yellowish highlight blob at mustache center — style break inconsistent with flat-color art.
Wide open mouth with visible teeth, crisp mustache outline, clean dark-red cavity, no seam or gloss artifacts.
Small round O-shaped opening, clean edges, mustache intact, no artifacts.
Larger, more distinctly round O-shaped opening than c0, clean crisp linework, best 'oh' read.
Same shape as c0 but with a rainbow/prism gloss artifact at the mustache-nose junction — style break inconsistent with flat-color art.

Both eyes are correctly closed (curved slits, not a wink), but zoomed inspection shows an off-color yellow/rainbow glint artifact at both eye corners — a style-break defect; held to strict blink standard, fails.
Eyes are fully open, identical in shape to BASE — no blink occurred at all.
Clean small mouth opening below mustache, mustache intact and gray, no seam/artifact — reads correctly as a slightly parted mouth.
Visible blue/teal color smudge artifact at the bottom-right corner of the mouth and a teal fleck on the mustache — style break, not flat-color art.

Wide, clearly-open maroon mouth with visible tongue, clean mustache, no artifacts — but pose baseline in this sheet shows the same degree of parting as half, so verify against 'half__c0' before wiring (kept as pass on shape/cleanliness grounds).
Opening is small and essentially the same size/shape as the half candidates — does not read as clearly more open than 'half'; fails the 'wide open' intent for its label.
Rounded vertical-oval opening with visible tongue, mustache parts naturally and stays intact, no seam artifacts — best O-shape of the oh set.
Bright white/glow smudge artifact on the cheek just left of the nose bridge, inconsistent with flat-color style — style break inside the regenerated region.
Round-ish opening with visible tongue, clean mustache, no artifacts — slightly wider/flatter than c0 but acceptable.
Not a clean blink: left eye reads as a wink crescent while the right eye shows a garbled dark reddish-brown shape instead of a closed eyelid — asymmetric and mangled.
Both eyes are still fully open with visible dark irises, essentially unchanged from BASE — no blink occurred.
Mouth opening size and mustache split are fine, but a spurious reddish-skin blob artifact appears below the mouth (not present in BASE) — off-model blemish inside the regenerated region.
Clean small-to-moderate mouth opening below mustache, tongue tip visible, mustache parts naturally, no seam artifacts. Clearly less open than the open__c0 candidate.
Wide, clearly open mouth with visible dark interior cavity, mustache splits cleanly, no seams or artifacts. Best 'open' candidate.

Mouth barely parted (reads closer to 'half' or even closed) — insufficient opening for 'open'. Also has a visible jagged red/white seam artifact at the mask boundary beside the mustache tip, absent in BASE.
No visible mouth opening at all — mustache and lower face are essentially identical to BASE's closed mouth. Fails the round-open-mouth requirement for 'oh'.
Plausible open-ish mouth shape, but a visible off-color seam (thin red/white/dark streak) is present at the mask boundary beside the mustache tip where BASE is clean skin.
Clean round-ish open mouth with tongue tip visible below, mustache parts naturally with intact shading strokes, no boundary seams. Best 'oh' candidate.
Right eye has a mangled skin/yellow-toned notch artifact poking into the black closed-eye shape (confirmed absent in BASE) — reads as a rendering glitch, not a clean closed eye.
Both eyes read as fully closed, matching BASE's closed-eye arcs; only a negligible sub-pixel fleck at one eye tip, not enough to break the shape. Best 'blink' candidate.
Lips fully closed, flat neutral line, no teeth/opening, no seam. Clean.
Fully closed with a very slight upward smile curve, no residual opening, clean seam.
Fully closed, slightly downturned line, no opening/teeth, clean seam.
Small-medium oval opening, area ~91% of BASE and clearly smaller than either open candidate; no teeth/tongue garbling, clean seam.
Slightly smaller opening than c0 (area ~84% of BASE), reads as the more clearly 'parted' variant, clean anatomy and seam.
Widest of all mouth candidates (clearly bigger than half/oh), dark cavity + tongue, a specular highlight streak reads as natural wet-mouth gloss, no garbling.
Wide open with visible upper/lower teeth strips, clean rendering, no garbled anatomy, though only marginally larger than BASE/half by pixel area (teeth rims eat into the dark-area measurement).
Round O-shaped opening, tongue visible, clean lip rim and seam. Shape is close to half/BASE size but reads as rounder.
Same round O shape, clean, near-identical to c0/c2; no artifacts.
Round O shape, clean, no artifacts; visually near-duplicate of c0/c1.
Both eyes fully closed with matching curved lash shapes, glasses frames intact/unwarped, no wink asymmetry. Passes.
Both eyes closed; a small white catchlight speck sits on the left lid (reads as gloss highlight, not an opening). Slightly lower quality than c0/c2 but not a wink and not a fail.
Cleanest closed-eye candidate: both eyes fully shut, symmetric, no highlight artifacts, glasses frames intact. Brows read slightly more knit/furrowed than BASE but not damaged.
Fully closed straight lip line, no teeth, no residual opening. Clean, on-model.
Fully closed, slight upturned/smirk curve to the line but no opening or teeth. Valid closed mouth, just a different corner shape than c0.
Fully closed line, no opening/teeth, clean seam.
Small-medium rounded opening, dark interior + tongue base, clearly less open than the open__ set. No teeth. Cleanest half.
Slightly larger parted opening than c0 but still clearly smaller than open__c0/c1. No garbling.
Wide open mouth with distinct white teeth strips top and bottom, large squared opening. Best open candidate.
Wide dark opening reaching toward chin with visible tongue; less crisp teeth definition than c0 and a faint pink smear at the lower seam, but reads clearly as wide open.
Rounded O-shaped opening, single subtle highlight, no exposed teeth strip — reads distinctly as a round vowel shape rather than a bared-teeth open mouth.
Opening has visible white teeth strips at both top and bottom rim like the open__ candidates, and is taller/more rectangular than round — reads as 'open' not a round O, wrong shape for the label.
Clean rounded O opening, nose blush mark preserved outside mask, no teeth exposure. Good round shape.
Both eyes fully closed with symmetric curved eyelid lines, eyebrows and glasses frames intact and unwarped.
Character's left eye (image right) is a garbled hook/gun-shaped mark instead of a smooth closed-lid curve — asymmetric and malformed versus the other eye. Fails the strict blink bar.
Both eyes fully closed with symmetric curved lid lines, glasses intact, matches BASE brow shape well.
Both eyes fully closed with natural curved lash lines, symmetric, glasses frames intact and unwarped. Clean pass.
Eyes are wide open with visible pupils — essentially identical to BASE's shocked open eyes. No blink occurred at all.
Both eyes fully closed, glasses intact. Minor lens glint highlight on right lens but consistent/plausible, no warping.
Full-res inspection shows a wide-open mouth with dark cavity, visible tongue/inner-lip, and a stray skin-colored blob artifact below the lip — not closed at all; thumbnail was misleading.
Mouth open with tongue sticking out — clearly not closed, no lip closure achieved.
Mouth open with a dark frown-shaped cavity — clearly not closed, no lip closure achieved.
Measured aperture is indistinguishable from BASE/open — full wide-open mouth, not 'clearly less open than open' as required for half.
Same failure as c0: aperture size matches full open mouth, no partial-parting achieved.
Wide open mouth with teeth top and corners plus tongue; on-model flat coloring, no seam or anatomy garbling. Slightly more embellished (extra corner teeth) than BASE style.
Wide open mouth, closest style match to BASE (thin tooth-line highlight, same cavity/tongue treatment), clean seam.
Round-ish open aperture; minor V-notch dip in the top tooth-line (slightly irregular) but not garbled anatomy or a style break.
Cleanest, most symmetric round O-shaped aperture, smooth top highlight line, no artifacts.
Round symmetric aperture, clean seam, consistent flat-color style.
Mouth still wide open with visible upper teeth bar and tongue — not closed at all, essentially identical to BASE's open mouth.
Mouth still wide open (same as BASE); also a stray white garbled fragment/highlight artifact at the top-right of the opening.
Lips do close to a thin line, but a garbled dark curved mark with a white sliver and pink shading appears on the right cheek/jaw near the mask seam — malformed secondary feature.
Mouth opening is the same size/shape as BASE (not 'clearly less open' than open); interior shows a brown gloss/gradient inconsistent with the flat-color style (BASE interior is flat black).
Same issue: opening unreduced from BASE, plus a visible brown gloss/gradient sheen across the mouth interior — style break.
Shape reads as wide open (fine), but interior shows a clear brown gradient/gloss highlight sweeping across it, unlike BASE's flat solid black — style break.
Same gloss/gradient style break in the mouth interior as open__c0; also a stray highlight streak wrapping the lower-left edge.
Interior stays flat (no gloss), but shape is essentially an unchanged copy of BASE's wide rectangular open mouth — not a round O-pucker.
Same non-round shape issue as oh__c0, plus a garbled gap/seam at the top of the mouth outline where skin tone bleeds through oddly.
Flat interior but shape is again just BASE's open mouth reproduced — no round O shape achieved.
Wink, not blink: left eye closed with a squiggly line, right eye fully open with visible round pupil. Fails the both-eyes-closed requirement outright.
Same wink failure — one eye closed, one eye wide open.
Same wink failure — one eye closed, one eye wide open.

Clean small parting under mustache, pink tongue-tip visible, mustache/nose/blush intact, no seam artifacts. Reads correctly as a subtle 'half' opening (measured opening area smallest of the half/open set).

Mustache accent line matches base's original fold detail (not a gloss artifact). Opening is noticeably larger/more toothy than half__c0 - on the wide side for 'half' but still clearly smaller than the best 'open' candidate, so it still reads as parted rather than wide open.
Largest, clearest mouth opening of the whole set (roughly 2.5x the area of half__c0) - correctly reads as wide open. Mustache clean, no seam or gloss issues.

FAIL: opening size is essentially identical to the half candidates (measured area ~2900 vs open__c0's ~6800) - does not read as 'wide open', indistinguishable from a half-parted mouth. Wrong magnitude for its label.
Clean round pink 'O' visible below mustache, mustache and face intact, no artifacts. Smallest of the oh set but shape is clearly round/O-shaped, not a slit like half.

Best roundness of the oh set (near 1:1 width:height opening), clear dark cavity with visible interior, mustache clean aside from a tiny natural notch at the center part (matches base's linework style, not an artifact).
Round-ish opening, moderate size, pink tongue visible, mustache and face clean. Solid but slightly less circular than oh__c1.
FAIL: left eye is closed/winked but right eye clearly still shows an open pupil and white sclera highlight - this is a wink, not a blink.
FAIL: same issue as blink__c0 - left eye closed, right eye visibly open with pupil and highlight intact. Wink, not a full blink.

Mouth line desaturates to a yellow/orange smudge and the glasses lens shows a visible tan-yellow contamination blob at its base — clear off-color patch at the mask boundary vs. BASE's clean brown lip line and clear lens.
Lips fully closed, line color and thickness match BASE closely, glasses lens stays clear with only a negligible edge tint. Best closed candidate.
Closed-lip line renders in an olive/green tint distinctly different from BASE's brown-maroon line — visible style/color break on the primary drawn element.
Small, clearly-parted opening with dark interior, no teeth peeking, lens stays essentially clean. Reads correctly as less-open than 'open'. Best half candidate.

Visible yellow/orange smudge contaminates the glasses lens at the mask seam (larger and more visible than c0's), and the opening shows a sliver of teeth, pushing the shape closer to 'open' than a true half-parted mouth.
Wide open mouth, teeth row and tongue rendered cleanly, lens stays clear; small dark speck right at the lower lip corner is minor.
Wide open mouth with teeth and tongue, natural shape, only a faint lens edge tint and tiny color flecks at the mouth corner (negligible at normal viewing scale). Best open candidate.
Rounded open-mouth shape distinct from 'open' and 'half', dark interior with visible top teeth sliver; a small green fleck at the lower lip corner is minor.
Visible tan/yellow smudge contaminates the glasses lens at the seam, and the mouth opening reads too close to the wide 'open' shape rather than a distinct round O.
Clean, compact rounded opening, no visible lens contamination, shape reads clearly as its own round-mouth viseme distinct from 'open'/'half'. Best oh candidate.
Both-eyes-implied lid fully closed under the glasses (skin-tone eyelid fill with a thin closed-lid crease replacing the open pupil), glasses frame intact and unwarped. Best blink candidate.
Eye region still shows a pale/whitish fill inside the lens rather than a convincingly closed lid — reads as ambiguous/half-closed, which fails the strict blink bar.
A distinct blue-colored smudge artifact appears at the eyebrow/lens-top boundary — visible off-palette color break near the eye region.

Small parted mouth beneath mustache, dark interior + pink lower lip visible, mustache intact and clean, no seam artifacts in the regenerated region. Clearly smaller/less open than the open/oh candidates -- solid 'half'.

Mouth opening is nearly as wide/tall as the open__c0 and oh__c1/oh__c2 candidates (measured comparable pixel area), so it fails to read as 'clearly less open than open' -- ambiguous degree for the half label even though the region itself is clean.
Wide-open mouth clearly larger than the half candidates, dark interior + pink tongue, mustache parts naturally, no garbling or seam issues.
Widest, most convincing wide-open mouth of the set; mustache parts naturally around it, clean edges, no artifacts. Best 'open'.
No mouth opening is visible -- face reads essentially identical to BASE under the mustache (confirmed low delta vs base in that immediate area). Absent shape for the 'oh' label.
Round-ish open mouth visible beneath mustache, plausible 'oh' shape, mustache intact; one sub-pixel stray dark/blue fleck at the mustache tip is negligible at normal viewing size.
Clean, symmetric round O-shaped opening, best roundness of the three oh candidates, mustache intact, no visible seam or artifact. Best 'oh'.

Eyes are closed asymmetrically: left eye is a thick crescent with an odd downward hook, right eye is a tiny, thin, disconnected sliver that reads as mangled/incomplete rather than a matching closed eye. Fails strict blink symmetry requirement.
Both eyes remain open black ovals (only slightly reshaped with a small comma-like hook), essentially unchanged from BASE -- this is not a blink at all.
